Chromostereopsis.question: The _____ was Visual illusion in color images.
Chromostereopsis.fact: Chromostereopsis is a visual illusion whereby the impression of depth is conveyed in two-dimensional color images, usually of red–blue or red–green colors, but can also be perceived with red–grey or blue–grey images. Chromostereopsis is usually observed using a target with red and blue bars and an achromatic background.

Over two centuries ago, the effect of color depth perception was first noted by Goethe in his Farbenlehre (Theory of Colours) in which he recognized blue as a receding color and yellow/red as a protruding color.
